subject.title: feat(github-copilot): support GitHub Enterprise data-residency Copilot auth

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's `github-copilot` auth/config/token-host boundary as the supported GHE data-residency Copilot implementation?
rationale: The implementation is well-proven and follows the preferred existing-provider direction, but it changes which hosts can receive GitHub OAuth/Copilot token traffic and adds provider-owned config/env/auth-method surface that automation should not approve alone.

options.title: Accept bounded provider-owned GHE routing
options.body: Land the PR after owner/security review confirms the `github.com`/single-label `*.ghe.com` allowlist, domain-scoped cache, and config/env precedence are the intended boundary.

options.title: Request a narrower surface before merge
options.body: Ask the branch to remove or change the interactive auth choice, env/config precedence, or SDK normalizer export if maintainers want a stricter config-only implementation.

options.title: Pause bundled support
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers decide GHE data-residency Copilot should remain plugin/ClawHub scope despite the existing-provider guidance.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded provider-owned GHE routing
recommendation.body: Land the PR after owner/security review confirms the `github.com`/single-label `*.ghe.com` allowlist, domain-scoped cache, and config/env precedence are the intended boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The discussion cites owner guidance from this handle and CONTRIBUTING.md lists this person for Security, which matches the auth/token boundary decision.
